## Create a GitHub Personal Access Token

Here are the step-by-step instructions to set up a GitHub personal access token (PAT):

::: {.callout-important}
Treat your access tokens like passwords and keep them secure (e.g. a password managing software).
:::

1.  Log in to your GitHub account.

![](images/screenshot-github-landing-page.png){width=100%}

2.  Click on your profile picture in the top-right corner of the page.

![](images/screenshot-github-profile-menu.png){width=100%}

3.  Select "Settings" from the dropdown menu.

![](images/screenshot-github-settings.png){width=100%}

4.  In the left sidebar, click on "Developer settings".

![](images/screenshot-github-developer-settings.png){width=100%}

5.  Click on "Personal access tokens".

![](images/screenshot-github-personal-access-tokens.png){width=100%}

6.  Click on **"Tokens (classic)"**.

![](images/screenshot-github-tokens-classic.png){width=100%}

7.  Click on "Generate new token" and from the dropdown menu select **"Generate new token (classic)".**

![](images/screenshot-github-generate-token.png){width=100%}

8.  In the "Note" field, give your token the name: GITHUB_PAT

![](images/screenshot-github-token-note.png){width=100%}

9.  Under Expiration, select "No expiration"

![](images/screenshot-github-token-expiration.png){width=100%}

10. Under "Select scopes", select: **repo, workflow, user**

![](images/screenshot-github-token-scopes.png){width=100%}

11. Click on "Generate token".

![](images/screenshot-github-generate-token-button.png){width=100%}

12. Your personal access token will be displayed on the screen. 

![](images/screenshot-github-token-created.png){width=100%}

13. Do not copy and store the token in a Word Document (DOCX). Copy and store the token in an appropriate password manager. If you do not have a password manager, you can use a text file (.txt), but make sure to keep it secure and do not share it with anyone.

![](images/screenshot-password-manager.png){width=100%}

::: {.callout-tip}
You will need this token in your pre-course work and throughout the course. Make sure to keep it secure and do not share it with anyone. If you lose the token, you will need to generate a new one.
:::

Continue with the next assignment.
